deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing gestures ('the tumor is here', 'This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a specific anatomical description ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that is not stated in the text and not confirmed by the text to be correct.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The lecturer said 'circumspect', which is a slip of the tongue for the pathological term 'circumscribed'. Correcting this slip to make the statement scientifically accurate is an allowed change.

considerations.sourcePassage: and has, if you like, invaded within this tissue.
considerations.reason: Rendering 'if you like' as 'in a sense' is an allowed stylistic variation that preserves the speaker's meaning and hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: you wouldn't be sampling all over the body
considerations.reason: Rephrasing 'sampling all over the body' as 'the whole body would not be sampled' is an allowed stylistic rewrite with the same meaning.
